Bug_Explanation: In this code, we are using Thread.notify() to wake up a thread that is waiting on an object. By doing this, we are only waking up one of the threads that are waiting on the object. If there are multiple threads waiting on the object, it's arbitrary which one gets woken up. To wake up all threads waiting on the object, we should use Thread.notifyAll().
